en.name: YOLO7 Tín (EN)
en.description: A friendly 21-year-old Vietnamese young man speaking clear, natural standard American English. Warm, patient and encouraging, like a kind older brother teaching. Medium pitch, moderate pace, clean studio recording.
en.sample_text: Hi everyone, I'm Tín. Welcome to YOLO7 English! Today we're at my mom's pho shop in Hẻm ninety-nine. Listen carefully: What would you like? Small or large? No onions, please. Now let's practice together. You've got seven seconds!

vi.name: YOLO7 Tín (VI)
vi.description: A warm 21-year-old young Vietnamese man from Saigon speaking Vietnamese with a natural Southern Vietnamese accent. Gentle, friendly and encouraging, like an older brother explaining a lesson. Medium pitch, clear diction, clean studio recording.
vi.sample_text: Chào cả nhà, mình là Tín. Hôm nay mình học cách gọi phở bằng tiếng Anh ngay tại quán của mẹ mình. Các bạn nghe kỹ nha: No onions, please, nghĩa là không hành nha. Giờ mình cùng luyện phản xạ bảy giây nhé!
